title: Grateful Dead Live at San Diego Sports Arena on 1973-11-14

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard captures a high‑energy set with a smoking Truckin’ > Too jam, soaring Eyes of the World and a standout Wharf Rat coda.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its flowing jams—Truckin' bursts into a trippy Too transition, rolls into an inspired Eyes of the World that even weaves in Me & My Uncle before snapping back to a Wharf Rat coda. Reviewers note the recording sounds clear and well‑balanced, letting the band’s high energy shine through.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 5 stars and highlighted strong musical moments with no technical complaints; soundboard quality is assumed excellent, yielding a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No issues mentioned; reviewers imply clear, balanced mix that showcases the performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fluid transitions with a standout jam from Truckin' into Too, then into Eyes of the World and an unexpected Wharf Rat coda; overall pacing feels relaxed yet adventurous.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass‑heavy jam out of Truckin' noted as a signal they were about to let loose, indicating strong Phil Lesh performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s vocal improvisation (eyeballing Me & My Uncle) during the Eyes jam is highlighted.
